CURRENT QUESTION:
share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH donor_stats AS (
    SELECT
        "Donor",
        COUNT(*) AS donation_count,
        SUM("Amount") AS total_amount
    FROM "donations"
    GROUP BY "Donor"
),
classified_donors AS (
    SELECT
        "Donor",
        CASE 
            WHEN donation_count > 1 THEN 'Repeat'
            ELSE 'One-time'
        END AS donor_type,
        total_amount
    FROM donor_stats
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        donor_type,
        SUM(total_amount) AS type_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS donor_count
    FROM classified_donors
    GROUP BY donor_type
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(type_amount) AS grand_total_amount
    FROM aggregated
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        (a.type_amount * 100.0) / NULLIF(t.grand_total_amount, 0),
        2
    ) AS share_percent,
    a.donor_count AS count_of_donors
FROM aggregated a
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE a.donor_type = 'Repeat'
```
